description: Driving-robot kit fitted to the forklift's own controls: steering robot on the wheel (fork around the spinner knob), accelerator, brake and inching pedal actuators, lift, tilt and side-shift lever actuators, direction-stalk, hand-brake, ignition-key and horn-button actuators, a cab camera and an IMU; its frame and mounts bolted to the truck, a 67 kg ballast strapped to the seat for the operator-presence switch (forklift/operator.py, kit fit)
